purpose: Default-settings comparison of oWALNUTS (dual averaging and JMLR Appendix C warmup) with CmdStan NUTS and nutpie on a fixed breadth set of posteriordb posteriors with reference draws; decides whether Appendix C becomes the default warmup.
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, owalnuts-paper, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean

metrics.gradients_total: owalnuts target_calls_total; cmdstan sum n_leapfrog__ (warmup+sampling); nutpie sum n_steps (warmup+sampling)
metrics.wall: seconds around the single sampler call, warmup included, compile excluded
metrics.wall_sampling_estimated: wall * gradients_sampling / gradients_total (all arms); cmdstan CSV elapsed times also recorded
metrics.ess_per_second: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / wall
metrics.ess_per_gradient: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / gradients_total; sampling-only variant also reported
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref)/sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2) with arviz mean MCSE on both sides; max |z| over parameters; flag if > 4; also max |mean - mean_ref|/sd_ref

appendix_c_analysis.per_model_ratio: r_grad = median_seeds(min bulk ESS/gradient, paper) / median_seeds(..., da); same for r_wall (min bulk ESS/s) and for tail
appendix_c_analysis.at_least_as_good: r_grad >= 0.9 and paper passes gates on every seed where da passes
appendix_c_analysis.overall: geometric mean of r_grad and r_wall over models with all seeds present for both arms
appendix_c_analysis.decision_rule: recommend Appendix C as default iff geomean r_grad >= 1.0 and at_least_as_good on every model; otherwise opt-in only, losing models named

predictions.P1: both oWALNUTS arms pass all gates on noncentered eight schools, the five regressions, arK, arma and both HMMs
predictions.P2: CmdStan and nutpie diverge on centered eight schools at adapt_delta 0.8; at least one oWALNUTS arm has zero divergences there
predictions.P3: the paper arm uses fewer total gradients than the DA arm on a majority of models
predictions.P4: CmdStan/nutpie have higher min-bulk-ESS/gradient than oWALNUTS on diamonds

decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results.
